description_expanded: ABOUT CASA SUNSHINE: Introducing a charming 2 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom townhome nestled in the desirable location of West Panama City Beach. This delightful townhome features two spacious bedrooms, each furnished with a luxurious king-size bed, ensuring a comfortable stay for up to four guests. In addition to its inviting living spaces, this pet-friendly accommodation allows guests to bring their furry companions along for a memorable beach getaway. Situated in a prime location near the vibrant attractions of Panama City Beach, this townhome offers a perfect blend of convenience and comfort for a relaxing and enjoyable stay on the scenic Gulf Coast. ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Beach Access 94 PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 1 minute walk to the beach * Charcoal grill * Large decks * Pet friendly PARKING: * Free parking up to 2 vehicles. PROPERTY RULES: * Maximum of 3 pets allowed. Weight limit is 50 lbs. A $150 pet fee applies. All pets must be approved in advance. Fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation. * Must Be 25 years or older to rent. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
